run_eval_with_checkpoint: run the eval script with a model checkpoint path and quantizer to evaluate retrieval performance
run_eval_with_pca: run the eval script with a pca-based checkpoint to evaluate PCA dimensionality reduction on a dataset
run_eval_on_validation_set: run the eval script with the --val flag to evaluate on the validation set instead of test
run_eval_on_gpu: run the eval script with device set to cuda to evaluate the model on GPU
run_eval_with_custom_base_size: run the eval script with a custom --size-base to limit the database size for evaluation
